notes: HBM -> VM WRITE PATH (G-VM-HBM-PATH, static successor of ot_hbm_svc_static_vm_delivery fed by the retired svc bands). Decision: COMPILER-WINDOWED K-PORT SHARE of all 32 PCs per quadrant (option 1 of grants_v7_1925 (3); no dedicated PCs, so SM weight bandwidth is lost only inside compiler-placed VM windows). Per quadrant: (a) vmks_<q><k> = ot_hbm_svc_vm_kshare #(SM=k) between svg_<q><k> and its 4 controllers (engine region, full_die_v16.engine_region): NORM passes the group K traffic; a window command (vm_*) holds new group requests at the K boundary (the allowed HBM flow-control boundary), drains the group beats in flight, issues 16 x len-4 reads per PC (64 slots, address {row,j[2:0],{col,j[3]},P^col^{row[1:0],j[2:0]},00}), steers the 64 returning beats by phase into a Gray SPSC FIFO to stream_clk and emits delivery fills; (b) vmdel_<q><b> = ot_hbm_svc_vmdel_lane x8 (the existing hardened v3 delivery lane, wires-only split parent flattened): landing (begin / fill / block_ready) and the compiler start -> 256 cycles of dq to VM bank b (sector = base + slot*32 + P); (c) vmfc_<q> = ot_vms_calendar_static #(W=89): one programme word per stream edge, fields begin_v[0:1), begin_bank[1:2), begin_epoch[2:18), start[18:19), start_bank[19:20), start_epoch[20:36), start_base_sector[36:52), vm_v[52:53), vm_bank[53:54), vm_epoch[54:70), vm_row[70:85), vm_col[85:89). Compiler rules: begin(bank,epoch) at or before the window command of the same bank/epoch; start no earlier than the bound on window drain + HBM return + CDC (landing start_ok checks block_ready and faults otherwise -- a schedule error is detected, never waited on); calendar_<q> reserves wslot WG+4 (dq) on all 8 banks for the 256 readout edges from start + 3 (lane pin registers). Fixed latencies added by the new leaf: group K request +1 hbm edge, group K response +1 hbm edge (II=1); VM beat -> fill_v: CDC 2 sync + 2 edges. Same window cost on every PC of the quadrant. (d) sfault_<q> = ot_hbm_svc_stack_fault: the channel-pair CA check + sticky fault join of controllers, groups, share leaves, delivery lanes and the calendar (status out to the host status consumer, G-STATUS). Write-back (VM -> HBM, G-DMA) can use the same window: ot_hbm_svc_vm_kshare passes group writes now; a VM write window is the natural extension, not built here.
